card.title: Sacred Procedure
card.instruction: Treat an ordinary activity as a solemn ritual. Protect every step, object, and tradition from casual interference.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please stand for the opening of the office fridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We acknowledge the light before approaching the shelf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then today we open it in remembrance.
